title: Enable Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) on NVIDIA with Xorg
summary: Enable G-Sync or G-Sync Compatible mode on NVIDIA GPUs using the nvidia-settings GUI.
prerequisites: Monitor supports G-Sync or G-Sync Compatible

steps.explain: Navigate to your GPU (e.g., GPU 0) and select your monitor (e.g., DP-0). Check 'G-SYNC Mode Available'. If it says 'G-SYNC Unvalidated', proceed to the next step.
steps.gui: Select GPU > Select Monitor > Check G-SYNC Mode Available

steps.explain: Go to 'X Server Display Configuration'. Click 'Advanced'. Check 'Allow G-SYNC on monitor not validated as G-SYNC Compatible'. Click 'Apply'.
steps.gui: X Server Display Configuration > Advanced > Check 'Allow G-SYNC on monitor not validated as G-SYNC Compatible' > Apply

steps.explain: Go to 'OpenGL settings'. Check 'Allow G-SYNC/G-SYNC Compatible'. Optionally check 'show G-SYNC indicator'. Click 'Apply'.
steps.gui: OpenGL settings > Check 'Allow G-SYNC/G-SYNC Compatible' > Apply

rollback.explain: Uncheck the G-SYNC options in nvidia-settings and click Apply.

warnings: If a monitor did fail NVIDIA's certification to be G-SYNC compatible, there may be issues with the experience such as poor image quality, flickering, or lack of VRR activation.
